summary: John's maternal 3rd great-grandmother per the tree; wife of Domenico Fiorillo.
bio: Tree: Saveria Colosimo (1848-1926). Colosimo is one of the commonest San Mango surnames: 652 entries in the 1674-1804 parish stati delle anime; Colosimo x14 in the mid-1990s San Mango phone directory; listed by ItalianSide among the town's traditional families. A Gaetano Colosimo, 40, witnessed Domenico Fiorillo's 1840 birth act (relationship unknown).
openQuestions: Birth act 1848 (San Mango Nati - Antenati covers to 1860)
